name: Artful Guile (Ex)
body:
Benefit: When using an ability that requires the rogue to spend a guile point as a swift action , she may spend one extra guile point to reduce that swift action to a free action . This ability may only be used once per round. This does not allow a rogue to use the same rogue talent more than once per round.
